june 4 Notes:


I completely missed today to be honest, but I don’t know if I would have found an entry regardless. We will take a look at some potential setups that I could have taken though.
,
To get started with my main setup, we had 10:00 provide a 1min entry that I would have most likely faded, and then a 5min setup that got edged. 9:30 open was bearish and at 10:00 open we got a move down to sweep london session lows then a move back up above 10:00. For this move above, 10:00 would be in premium of the range instead of discount but it would be inside a 1min fvg and you could have taken it and it woulf have played out. This entry would be a little too risk for me and even though things are aligning well and it looks strong, I wouldn’t want to take the first retracement right as we displace above 10:00.  (Screenshot 1)
,
If we waited for the 5min candle close though, then 10:00 would be in a 5min fvg. It is still in premium, but we have now seen a stronger move above and a stronger confluence is supporting out entry. This gets edged though by a few points and you would be left behind. In this case scenario I think it is smart to fade that initial setup and getting left behind sometimes is what happens when going for precision entries. (Screenshot 2)
,
I saw powell take a setup from this point and I think it is interesting; price trades up into 18:00 creating a range which it retraces into after the 18:00 tap. On the 5min there isn’t too clear of an entry, but we get a strong displacement after hitting discount. on the 3min we have a cisd entry that gives a 0dd entry and is a solid trade. (Screenshot 3)
,
Today showed some nice complexity on the 10:00 open and gave a good blueprint for how to trade it. I think that it is also a good thing I could not trade today because I have taken 5 trades in the past three days which is a little more than more than normal. I will be looking to trade overnight session tonight after my nice day off to recover psychologically.
,

june 3 Notes:


Today was one of the most unfortunate trading days for me. I took 3 trades, first stopped in profit then went to tp, second stopped at breakeven, and third lost. So in total I went breakeven for the day.
,
Market opened lower at 9:30 all the way until 10:00 where we got a retracement without any trading below 10:00, so I thought we might bet a move lower. We traded up and then got an amd model and the manipulation traded into a 4h rb and made a 5min rb which I entered short off of. The move instantly had a strong reaction and then came back up near my breakeven before going lower so I adjusted my stop loss to the new swing high. Price came back up one more time and hit my stop, but not my entry level and then went to tp. (Screenshots 1 & 2)
,
I think this trade had a really really strong entry and was a really good trade, but maybe for my style of trade since I am not going for huge huge swing trades I shouldn’t traill my stop past breakeven. It seems like every time I do I end up in this unfortunate situation.
,
The next trade was also unfortunate cause it was a no drawdown entry that gave me 40 points before stopping me out at breakeven. Price came down and below 10:00 reacting to a 5min fvg and then showed displacement past it putting 10:00 in a 5min fvg which I entered off of. This is a very strong 10:00 model for me that I was super confident it as well, but I got stopped on this too. This is also a trade that I am confused about losing because it seemed so strong and we got such a nice reaction. (Screenshot 3)

messages.content_text:
DAY 9  : 2 TRADES 1 BE 1 L

Technical analysis
Bullish bias into 1 hr >5 min FVG tap. TFA 30 sec, didn't find breaker leg, used 15 second. found it, plotted ote aligned with breaker and limited that. entry was perfect. my issue was that i wanted to target -4 and above. because of previous volatility and decorrelation with ES, price retraced all the way back down and broke me even. Second trade (on funded), which was a rule break, and also outside my trading window, was trying to catch the retrace from po3 of -2 to OTE of level. could have work if es was correlated but was showing signs of decorrelations with SMT, i should have used that as a sign to not take the trade. also it was out of the trading window i allotted myself. first execution was good, 2nd wasn't ideal. 

Psychological analysis
The first trade was a bit rushed as it was on the 15 min time frame. i decided to use my eval as i wasn't so sure. trade played out very well. only issue was that i wanted it to reach new ATH but price had other plans. from the bearish smt that es was showing, i should have close the trade then and there, but since it was an eval, i took the gamble. which now feels like ass because i gave up 1600 dollars and sat nearly 3 hours for a break even. it was also out of my trading window, and i didn't realize that for the second trade. i was also getting emotional sitting through the second trade. perhaps some impatience was setting in. probably should not be running two trades at once. 

takeaways: humble TP's, focus on decorrelations, don't trade outside timing window, account for mental bandwidth. (edited)

Day 7 - 02/06/26 (1H RB ) (Win)

Bought a 25k No-Activation Fee Apex Account. I didn't meet the profit target or blow my account on my previous eval before re-bill date and it just disappeared.

When first opening the charts I was looking for areas I could possibly expect to see bullish delivery from but after looking at the hourly chart I had strong conviction in seeing bearish delivery from where price was currently trading before a continuation higher.
,


Before even identifying the 1H RB I saw that price had rallied extremely bullish from midnight open with no retest of this level and minimal mitigation of 02:00 open. Discount of this very premium price leg had not been met and aligning with discount was an unmitigated hourly gap and hourly breaker.
,


The reason I saw this as a high probability RB was because…
,

It was a HTF RB
This wick swept the previous hourly wick high and contained Engineered Liquidity
Had a strong bearish body close but still remaining in heavy premium
Tapped into the most premium bearish FVG on the previous bearish leg
Mitigated 0.705 of this range
Trading at 18:00 KO when formed


I set a LMT order a few points below CE with a 10 point SL, although a super clean setup, this went against an original loose bullish bias I wanted to trade with, and against the previous month and bit of narrative so I entered with half risk.
,


I originally targeted the first internal low for around a 1:7RR, when filled price rejected nicely and was selling off efficiently to my target. Price started chopping heavy around 8:15pm after meeting OTE of the LTF bullish range, after this strong bullish reaction I looked on the 15m TF to see that price had formed a nice 15m RB that followed my rules but also going with the overall bullish narrative. So I trailed my TP above CE of this wick.
,
Ended up being a really painful trade to sit through even after trailing breakeven but my original TP was met and even further mitigating discount of the range.
